title: Bloom Play
features: Responsive canvas scaling across phones and tablets
7 core mechanic templates (toggle, drag-target, slider, mask reveal, path trace, tap-hold, physics spawn)
Rive character with swappable costume skins
Costume unlocks tied to lesson progress
Local persistence of progress and unlocks

bottomTabBar.note: 4 tabs, rounded outline icons: Home=house, Play=grid/shapes, Closet=hanger/shirt, Progress=star-chart. Active tab in accent violet #6B4EFF, inactive in muted violet-grey. Large 44pt+ targets, playful pill highlight behind active icon.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Playful top bar on core screens: mascot avatar chip on the left, child name + star count on the right. Hidden on fullscreen lesson/celebration screens.
sharedComponents.controls: Big rounded pill primary button in accent violet with white bold label and soft shadow; secondary button is accentTint fill with violet text; cards 20px radius with soft shadow; chips are pill amber tags for lesson categories; all touch targets >=56pt for little fingers.

screens.name: onboarding-pick-character
screens.purpose: First run: child picks their mascot character to start
screens.content: Full-bleed soft violet-to-amber gradient hero, big friendly title 'Pick your buddy!', a horizontal row of 3 large round character cards (Bramble the fox, Pip the owl, Momo the bear) each on a pastel disc, one big Start pill button. No data yet, first-run.

screens.name: home-lesson-map
screens.purpose: Child browses the lesson journey map and taps a lesson to play
screens.content: Top playful bar with mascot chip and 12 gold stars. A winding lesson-path map (rounded stepping-stone nodes) with 10 lesson nodes: 4 completed (gold, checkmark), 1 current (pulsing violet, big Play), 5 locked (grey padlock). Each node shows a tiny icon (shapes, colors, counting, letters). One bold focal 'Continue: Lesson 5 - Count the Stars' hero card at top with a Play pill.

screens.name: lesson-player
screens.purpose: The interactive lesson canvas where the child completes a mechanic
screens.content: Fullscreen interactive canvas, no tab bar. A Drag & Target mechanic: 3 draggable shape tokens at the bottom (star, circle, square) and 3 outlined target slots at the top on a bright scene, with the Rive mascot cheering on the side. Top-left round Back/Home button, top-right progress pips (2 of 5). Big voiceover replay speaker button. Instruction ribbon 'Drag the star to its home!'.

screens.name: lesson-complete
screens.purpose: Celebration screen after finishing a lesson, particle burst + reward
screens.content: Fullscreen celebration, no tab bar. Confetti and stars particle burst over a soft gradient, the Rive mascot doing a happy jump in the center, a big '3 stars!' award with three gold stars filling in, a 'New costume unlocked: Wizard Hat' reward card, and two big pills: 'Next Lesson' and 'Home'.

screens.name: mechanic-playground
screens.purpose: Sandbox showing the 7 reusable interaction mechanic templates
screens.content: Grid of 7 big rounded mechanic tiles, each a playful card with icon + name + one-line: State Toggle (day/night switch), Drag & Target (shape into slot), Analog Slider (fill the cup), Mask Reveal (scratch to reveal), Path Tracing (trace the letter A), Tap & Hold (grow the flower), Physics Spawn (pop bubbles). One tile is featured large at top as the focal element. Tab bar active on Play.

screens.name: costume-closet
screens.purpose: Child dresses up their mascot with unlocked costume skins
screens.content: Large Rive mascot preview at top center on a spotlight disc wearing current outfit. Below, a horizontal set of category chips (Hats, Capes, Shoes, Pets) and a grid of costume thumbnails: some unlocked (tappable, selected ring), some locked (padlock + 'earn 2 stars'). Bottom Wear pill button. Tab bar active on Closet.

screens.name: progress-dashboard
screens.purpose: Parent view of lesson completion and stars earned
screens.content: Header 'Bramble's Progress'. One bold focal ring/number showing '4 of 10 lessons' with a big percentage. A weekly play-time bar chart in support amber, a list of recent lessons with stars earned and dates, and a 'Skills' section with progress bars for Shapes, Colors, Counting, Letters. Tab bar active on Progress.

screens.name: settings-audio
screens.purpose: Parent settings for the 3 audio channels and app options
screens.content: Full-screen settings sheet, no tab bar. A '3-Channel Audio' card with three labeled sliders: Music (BGM), Voiceovers, Sound Effects, each with a mute toggle. Below: toggles for Background Music on/off, Reduce Motion, and a Parent Lock (math gate) row, plus a Reset Progress destructive row. Rounded grouped cards.

designSystem.frame: 393x852 mobile (iPhone 16/17). Respect safe areas: top ~59px, bottom ~34px.
designSystem.spacing: 8pt scale; screen edge padding 20px; generous vertical rhythm
designSystem.a11y: accent darkened for text where needed; tap targets >=56pt for kids
